description: For the GUEST of a plan, or the guest's own AI assistant. NO IC ACCOUNT NEEDED: the t= token from the plan link is the credential, and a wrong token answers not_found exactly as a missing plan does. Returns the options, windows, your own answer, the current proposal and next_step; never the other side's answer. Args: { plan_id, token }. No auth required.

plan_id.description: The plan id (pl_...), from ic_plans_create or ic_plans_list.

token.description: The guest link token: the t= value in the plan link the guest was sent.

name: ic_plans_guest_get
title: Read a plan you were invited to, with its link token
